scripts.test: npm run test:localization && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:integration: node --test tests/integration-api.test.js tests/postgres-pagination.test.js tests/global-context.test.js tests/r2-storage.test.js tests/image-processing.test.js tests/product-media.test.js tests/cloudflare-stream.test.js tests/video-safety.test.js tests/video-safety-adapter.test.js tests/video-safety-dispatcher.test.js tests/cache.test.js tests/database-health-monitor.test.js tests/database-recovery.test.js tests/server-lifecycle.test.js tests/video-health-monitor.test.js
scripts.deploy:worker:frontend: npm run build:vercel && npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml
scripts.test:feed-production: node tests/frontend-core.test.js && node --test tests/postgres-pagination.test.js && playwright test tests/e2e/pagination-bootstrap.spec.js tests/e2e/cls-hardening.spec.js --reporter=list && playwright test tests/e2e/app.spec.js --grep "gallery|swipe|edge to edge|installed PWA|browser back from the first product|refreshing a product deep link|logged in sellers can scroll|guest home renders|vertical page scroll" --reporter=list
